packageRules.description: `testcontainers-modules` re-exports `testcontainers` types, so the two have to move together or the resolver fails outright. Group them into one PR.

`testcontainers-modules` 0.15 depends on `testcontainers ^0.27`, and no release of it accepts 0.28 yet. Bumping `testcontainers` alone gives `failed to select a version for testcontainers`. Drop this cap once a `testcontainers-modules` release targets 0.28.
